versions.content: Physical dimension Another important part of the semantics associated with a data type is its physical dimension. Units are used to augment the value with additional information like m/s or liter . This is necessary for a correct inter- pretation of the physical value for input and output processes. 411 of 1124  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 The conversion of values into other units like km/h into miles/h is also possible. There- fore, the unit involves information about its physical dimensions.
